text: Based on the evidence from NASA FIRMS data, there were no active fire or thermal anomaly detections on the property (ASSET-F04) during the period from October 4, 2026, to November 3, 2026. The data from sensors VIIRS_SNPP, VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21, and MODIS covered the entire period, and all sensors reported zero detections intersecting the asset. Therefore, we can confirm that there was no burning on this property during the specified period.
